in_sanskrit.name: मन्न
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who thinks, contemplates, meditates

in_marathi.name: Mannu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mannu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mannu is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'manas', which means 'mind' or 'intellect'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to have great potential and intelligence. In Hindu mythology, the god Manas is the embodiment of the mind and intellect.
